description: Header file defining the EventMessageQueueWrapperAidl class, which implements an AIDL-based wrapper for sensor event message queues in Android HAL.

classes.name: EventMessageQueueWrapperAidl
classes.description: A wrapper class implementing sensor event message queue using AIDL in Android HAL.

methods.name: getEventFlagWord
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the atomic flag word indicating event status.

methods.name: availableToRead
methods.description: Returns the number of events available to read from the queue.

methods.name: availableToWrite
methods.description: Returns the number of slots available for writing events.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads events from the queue and converts them to HIDL format.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes events to the queue after converting from HIDL format.

methods.name: writeBlocking
methods.description: Performs a blocking write of events with notification parameters.

methods.name: getQuantumCount
methods.description: Returns the quantum count of the message queue.
